decision.observation: Drifted hard left into the pines: 7 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The car sits among pine trunks with the wide gravel road 4-5 car widths to its right, lined by coloured marker posts and spectators; a boulder is below-left.
decision.hypothesis: The road is the only sensible target and lies directly right, so a long W+D beat should arc the car out of the trees toward the post-lined verge.
decision.memory: Plain W on this post-lined straight repeatedly drifts left or right into the pines; corrections need to be long (1.0-1.2 s) since grass is slow and the gap is several car widths.
